openai-codex-open-source-fund.max_award_basis: Up to USD 25,000 API credits per project grant, not the USD 1 million program pool. Not cash.

goose-open-source-agent-grants.max_award_basis: USD 100,000 for one 12-month project grant, paid against milestones. Discretionary renewals and separate project applications are not included.

inference-net-ai-compute-grants.max_award_basis: Up to USD 10,000 in free compute for one project grant. Not cash.

devpost-build-with-ai-basics-2026.max_award_basis: First place is USD 1,250. Rules allow only one ranked prize per project; the USD 2,500 pool is not one entrant's award. Unpriced participation badges and publicity are excluded.

osff-small-scale-high-impact-firmware-co.max_award_basis: Upper end of the published EUR 1,000–7,500 funding range for one selected proposal; discretionary award, not guaranteed funding.

aws-ircai-compute-for-climate-fellowship.max_award_basis: Up to USD 200,000 AWS credits per selected startup, not the USD 2 million cohort pool. Not cash; unselected-applicant credits are an alternative benefit, not an additional winner award.

hacker-initiative-signal-noise-grant-202.max_award_basis: Upper end of the published USD 5,000–25,000 grant range for one proposal. Awards may be below the requested amount.

digital-science-catalyst-grant-agentic-w.max_award_basis: At most GBP 25,000 for a proposal. The organizer may split this award across recipients, so a recipient could receive less.

nlnet-ois-restack-first-open-call-2026.max_award_basis: Upper end of EUR 5,000–50,000 sought for one initial proposal. Subsequent discretionary scale-up awards are outside this entry's ceiling.

nlnet-ois-codesupply-first-open-call-202.max_award_basis: First proposal allows at most EUR 50,000. The EUR 60,000 lifetime applicant cap includes later separate proposals and is not available through this one entry.

amazon-build-ship-shape-developer-hackat.max_award_basis: One Fire TV or Alexa+ first-place award (25,000 cash + 15,000 AWS credits), plus one mini-challenge (5,000 cash + 5,000 credits): 30,000 cash and 20,000 nominal credits. Rules permit only one track and one mini-challenge per project. Separate submissions, limited build credits and unpriced publicity are excluded.

principia-ai-compute-grants.max_award_basis: USD 1,000–10,000 is a typical grant range, not a stated maximum; a per-entry ceiling remains unverified.
